title: 獅子洋隧道~Shiziyang Tunnel
focus: 混合掌子面、高速軌道與水下接合~Mixed faces, high-speed track and underwater connection
summary: 國家鐵路局公開技術資料列獅子洋隧道10.8公里、雙孔單線，並記錄2011年12月通車及軟土、土岩複合與岩層的變化。本課從地層切換到結構和軌道平順性，串接長距離盾構、接合測量、列車氣動及救援；公開設計數字與本課假想模型分開呈現。~The National Railway Administration records Shiziyang as 10.8 km with twin single-track bores, opening in December 2011 through soft soil, mixed and rock strata. This course links ground transitions to structural and track geometry, long shield drives, connection surveys, train aerodynamics and rescue, keeping published design context separate from teaching calculations.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 獅子洋總隧道與盾構段的範圍不同，教材先確認雙孔單線的計量方式，不把兩孔相加當列車行程。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Total tunnel and shielded sections have different extents; define twin single-track measurement without adding both bores into train travel distance. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=19.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=19.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為21.56 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=19.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=19.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 21.56 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把雙孔工程量當單趟長度會使時間和容量估算加倍。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Using twin-bore quantities as one journey length doubles time and capacity inputs. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Shiziyang Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 公開資料記載軟土至土岩複合及岩層變化，本課研究混合面比例和裂隙如何共同改變掘進反應。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~Published ground transitions motivate analysis of mixed-face proportions and fractures that change boring response together. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0045045 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m². Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0045045 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把所有扭矩峰當岩石變硬會漏掉面內不均和設備因素。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~Treating all torque peaks as harder rock misses face heterogeneity and equipment causes. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For Shiziyang Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 獅子洋水下地層的水壓教材採分層測壓，不以同一海面水頭代表所有軟硬交界。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Use layered pressure observations rather than assigning one sea-level head to every soft-hard interface. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=108 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1059.48 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1165.43 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=108 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1059.48 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1165.43 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較不同層位孔壓與潮位，保留反應延遲。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare layer-specific pore pressures and tide with response lag preserved. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 低透水層的延遲水壓可能被短時讀值漏掉。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Short observations can miss delayed pressure in low-permeability layers. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較不同層位孔壓與潮位，保留反應延遲。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Shiziyang Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare layer-specific pore pressures and tide with response lag preserved. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 有效掘進利用率~Effective boring utilisation
units.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時~Boring utilisation and equipment downtime
units.mechanism: 長距離盾構的磨耗與停機需要按軟土、混合面及岩段分類，教材不以單一平均進尺判斷所有區段。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。~Classify wear and downtime by soft soil, mixed face and rock rather than judging all reaches by one average advance. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：切削速率=2.07 m/h；有效利用率=0.295 無因次。D=24vu=14.6556 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為16.1212 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=2.07 m/h; utilisation=0.295 dimensionless. D=24vu=14.6556 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 16.1212 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 逐刀具位置比較磨耗與地層暴露時間。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare wear by cutter position and time exposed to each ground type. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 平均磨耗可能掩蓋局部刀具先失效造成的非對稱作用。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。~Mean wear conceals early local cutter failure and asymmetric loading. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.
units.misconception: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。~A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
units.practice: 本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：逐刀具位置比較磨耗與地層暴露時間。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。~For Shiziyang Tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Compare wear by cutter position and time exposed to each ground type. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.

units.anchor: 襯砌背後幾何空隙~Geometric lining annulus
units.title: 背填連續性與體積帳~Backfill continuity and volume balance
units.mechanism: 高速軌道對沉陷敏感，獅子洋教材把背填幾何空隙與實際地層損失分開，不以注量當沉陷控制證明。盾尾空隙須由背填恢復襯砌與地層的接觸，但幾何空隙不是必然注入量。超挖、地層吸收、回流和材料體積變化都會改變收支；注入量達到目標仍不代表每個位置填滿，需要把壓力、時間與後續變形一起判讀。~Track geometry is sensitive to settlement; separate annular void from actual ground loss and do not use grout volume alone as proof of control. Backfill restores contact across the shield-tail gap, but geometric void is not the required injected volume. Overbreak, absorption, return and material volume change alter the balance. Meeting a volume target does not prove complete spatial filling; pressure, timing and later deformation must be interpreted together rather than using a single total.
units.model: 原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.76 m；襯砌外徑=8.46 m；環長=1.5 m。V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=6.08605 m³。僅把環長增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.69466 m³。邊界：同心幾何空隙，不等於實際灌漿需求或完成證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.76 m; lining diameter=8.46 m; ring length=1.5 m. V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=6.08605 m³. Increasing only ring length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.69466 m³. Boundary: Concentric geometric void, not actual grout demand or proof of completion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 結合注壓、注量、環片浮動和地表或孔內位移。用環片及開挖尺寸計算幾何空隙，核對注入回流質量與時間戳，再以適當無損檢測及變形資料查局部缺填。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Combine pressure, volume, segment flotation and ground or tunnel movement. Calculate the annulus from lining and excavation dimensions, reconcile injected/returned mass and timing, then use suitable nondestructive and deformation evidence for local gaps. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 高注量可能伴隨流失，並不能保證軌道支承均勻。局部通道讓材料回流時，總注量可能正常但背後仍有空洞，環片變形與接頭滲漏可能延後出現。~High take may reflect loss and does not ensure uniform track support. Preferential return paths can give normal total injection while leaving voids, with delayed segment distortion and leakage.
units.misconception: 灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。~Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的交付需回答：結合注壓、注量、環片浮動和地表或孔內位移。將每環幾何、材料批次及注入回流紀錄綁定，缺填診斷由土建及地工共同確認，後續處置不只追求增加總注量。~For Shiziyang Tunnel, the geometric lining annulus handover must address the following evidence: Combine pressure, volume, segment flotation and ground or tunnel movement. Link each ring to geometry, material batch and injection/return records; structural and ground teams diagnose gaps together rather than merely increasing volume.

units.anchor: 襯砌環向壓縮~Lining hoop compression
units.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度~Ring force and joint flexibility
units.mechanism: 公開技術背景包含不同地層對應結構，本課用薄環示例後指出內襯與縱向構件需另建空間模型。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。~Different ground-dependent structures require a spatial model for internal lining and longitudinal members beyond a thin-ring example. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.68 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.48 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.68 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.48 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較環向應變、縱向沉陷和軌道基座反應。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare hoop strain, longitudinal settlement and track-support response. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只驗環向壓縮會漏掉軟硬交界縱向彎曲。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。~Hoop compression alone misses longitudinal bending across a stiffness transition. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。~Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：比較環向應變、縱向沉陷和軌道基座反應。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。~For Shiziyang Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Compare hoop strain, longitudinal settlement and track-support response. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 水下長驅接合需把控制網誤差與盾構姿態分開，獅子洋教材分析相向掘進的方向累積。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~Underwater connection requires separation of network error from machine attitude, including direction accumulation in opposing drives. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=5280 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0665552 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0732107 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=5280 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0665552 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0732107 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 獨立核對兩端原始角距及接合前探測。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Independently check raw observations from both ends and preconnection surveys. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 盾構姿態看似正常可能只是跟隨偏移的導向基準。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~Normal machine attitude may merely follow a biased guidance reference. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：獨立核對兩端原始角距及接合前探測。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Shiziyang Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently check raw observations from both ends and preconnection surveys. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.anchor: 入口壓力擾動~Portal pressure disturbance
units.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級~Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale
units.mechanism: 高速列車的動壓與洞口波形不同，教材以速度平方尺度說明為何還需阻塞比和緩衝結構分析。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。~Dynamic pressure differs from portal wave shape; velocity-squared scaling explains why blockage and entrance structures still need analysis. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=59 m/s。q=ρv²/2=2088.6 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2527.21 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=59 m/s. q=ρv²/2=2088.6 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2527.21 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步量測速度和多位置壓力，辨識反射到達。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Synchronise speed and pressure at several locations to identify reflected arrivals. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 直接用動壓預測舒適性會忽略列車與隧道幾何。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。~Using dynamic pressure alone for comfort ignores train and tunnel geometry. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort.
units.misconception: 動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。~A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：同步量測速度和多位置壓力，辨識反射到達。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。~For Shiziyang Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise speed and pressure at several locations to identify reflected arrivals. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 水下雙孔鐵路的救援需確定列車停車位置和鄰孔狀態，教材將下車流率和步行分開。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Subsea twin-bore rescue depends on stopping position and receiving-bore state; separate detraining flow from walking. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=118 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=568 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為613 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=118 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=568 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 613 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以不同停車點演練門位及可用路徑。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Exercise door positions and usable routes for different stopping points. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 最短路徑未必對應所有車廂都能立即進入。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~The shortest route may not be immediately accessible from every carriage. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：以不同停車點演練門位及可用路徑。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Shiziyang Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Exercise door positions and usable routes for different stopping points. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 混合地層的結構與軌道維護需要共同里程索引，教材把病害、地質和施工背填資料連結。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Structure and track maintenance across mixed ground need common chainage linking defects, geology and grouting records. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=119 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.5546 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.2101 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=119 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.5546 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.2101 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 從軌道不平順點回查地層界面與內襯施工批次。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace a geometry anomaly to ground transition and lining construction batches. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只修軌道幾何而不查持續地層變形可能反覆返工。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Correcting track alone without investigating continuing ground movement causes repeated work. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從軌道不平順點回查地層界面與內襯施工批次。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Shiziyang Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a geometry anomaly to ground transition and lining construction batches. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「環向受力與接縫柔度」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0045045 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.68 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.48 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate ring force and joint flexibility. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m². Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0045045 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.68 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.48 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2011 年公開記錄：獅子洋隧道於12月開通營運。國家鐵路局公開技術資料列獅子洋隧道10.8公里、雙孔單線，並記錄2011年12月通車及軟土、土岩複合與岩層的變化。本課從地層切換到結構和軌道平順性，串接長距離盾構、接合測量、列車氣動及救援；公開設計數字與本課假想模型分開呈現。本課把「混合掌子面、高速軌道與水下接合」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2011: Shiziyang Tunnel opens for service in December. The National Railway Administration records Shiziyang as 10.8 km with twin single-track bores, opening in December 2011 through soft soil, mixed and rock strata. This course links ground transitions to structural and track geometry, long shield drives, connection surveys, train aerodynamics and rescue, keeping published design context separate from teaching calculations. The course treats mixed faces, high-speed track and underwater connection as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 10.8 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 10.8 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2011 年事件：獅子洋隧道於12月開通營運。~2011 event: Shiziyang Tunnel opens for service in December.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=19.6 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=19.6 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=19.6 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 19.6 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「破碎帶連通性」：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.004095 m³/s；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching fault-zone connectivity: conductivity=5e-06 m/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.004095 m³/s; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「襯砌背後幾何空隙」：開挖外徑=8.76 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=6.08605 m³；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching geometric lining annulus: excavated diameter=8.76 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 6.08605 m³; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「襯砌環向壓縮」：均勻外壓=0.68 MPa，其餘輸入依單元，結果=6.8 MPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching lining hoop compression: uniform external pressure=0.68 MPa, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 6.8 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.
